737:t_004:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「What are you planning to do!?」

737:t_004:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「Here we go! We'll seal him inside a dimensional barrier strengthened to the max!」

737:t_004:6.en:
$$エスター$$
「$$Ｚクリスタル$$! Answer everyone's feelings!」

737:t_016:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「We'll seal your divine power with the power of our feelings!」

737:t_016:2.en:
$$葵$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! This is where you meet your end!」

737:t_016:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Impossible! I... I am an $$御使い$$...!」

737:t_016:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Nothing in this world is absolute!」

737:t_016:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It's time you paid for everything you've done over the last 120 million years!」

737:t_017:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I-I am...! I aaaaaaam!!」

737:t_018:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「I sealed him inside the dimensional barrier. He can't come back now.」

737:t_005:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「To think you would fall behind mere humans.」

737:t_006:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I can't believe it...! $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ actually lost!」

737:t_006:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「His power must have waned through complacency in the mere 12,000 years since we last saw him.」

737:t_006:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Well... he was driven out of the ranks of the $$御使い$$s, after all. I guess that's all he amounts to.」

737:t_006:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「But we must avenge him, if only to show these Earthlings the power of the $$御使い$$s.」

737:t_006:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「You're awfully kind to someone who killed your own comrade!」

737:t_006:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Wasn't $$サクリファイ$$ your comrade!?」

737:t_006:7.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Are you saying $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ killed $$サクリファイ$$?」

737:t_006:8.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Absurd. Do you think a petty lie like that could shake us, the emissaries of the Supreme God?」

737:t_006:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's no lie! He took $$サクリファイ$$ and...!」

737:t_007:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Filthy $$バアル$$! Will you pin your crimes on our comrade $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ to cover up your own deeds!?」

737:t_007:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Too bad for you! $$テンプティ$$ and the others are $$御使い$$s... beings completely free of all conflict and lies!」

737:t_007:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Accursed $$バアル$$! You not only infiltrated $$カオス・コスモス$$, you even defile our $$エス・テラン$$!」

737:t_007:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hold on! Are you calling us this $$バアル$$!?」

737:t_007:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Those avatars of endless destruction served the force that seeks to vanish... You destroyed them, so you are the true $$バアル$$!」

737:t_007:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「No... it isn't just you! Over these 120 million years, the universe has become an evil world infested with $$バアル$$!」

737:t_007:9.en:
$$シン$$
「Is that how you've been making false accusations to destroy galaxies!?」

737:t_007:10.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「They aren't false accusations! They're the very truth!」

737:t_007:11.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Very well! We shall show you our power once more!」

737:t_008:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「I confirm the annihilation of the Cartwheel Galaxy in World 41.」

737:t_008:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Next is the $$ユーグトス銀河$$ in World 6!」

737:t_009:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're so weird! Why are you so angry just because some galaxies with nothing to do with you got destroyed!?」

737:t_009:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Then let me ask you! You're the administrators of all parallel worlds, so why are you doing this!?」

737:t_009:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Because that is our duty... the duty of the $$御使い$$s!」

737:t_009:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Who ever asked you to do that!?」

737:t_009:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「A mission is not something another gives you! It is something you impose upon yourself!」

737:t_009:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We judge sin to guide every universe rightly! That is the one absolute way to save the universe from collapse!」

737:t_009:9.en:
$$レド$$
「They're just like $$ストライカー#pilot$$! They intend to eliminate everything except their own idea of what's right!」

737:t_009:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We have no choice... but to fight...」

737:t_009:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It looks like you've recognized our power and gotten scared.」

737:t_009:12.en:
$n
「Shut up, you devil who enjoys people's suffering.」

737:t_009:14.en:
$n
「Let me spell it out so even your empty head can understand. I have absolutely no intention of entertaining you.」

737:t_009:16.en:
$$アルト$$
「I thought we could talk with you to prevent the universe's great collapse, but it seems that was pointless too!」

737:t_009:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「There will be no reconciliation when we settle things with you!」

737:t_009:18.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You fools! That is precisely why I call you $$バアル$$!」

737:t_009:19.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That is why we will exterminate you and stop the universe's great collapse!」

737:t_009:20.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「With $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ lost to us, that is the only means we have left!」

737:t_009:21.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You're saying the great collapse will stop if we disappear!?」

737:t_009:22.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You finally understand! Are you still going to come at us!?」

737:t_009:23.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Or is it this? Do you think it doesn't matter what happens to the universe, as long as your petty pride is satisfied?」

737:t_009:24.en:
$n
「You still don't understand! You people are...!」

737:t_009:25.en:
$$ランド$$
「Stop, $n! Nothing we say will get through to them!」

737:t_009:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Now I understand why $$ヴィルダーク$$ and $$アサキム$$ sought power above all else.」

737:t_009:27.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Words won't reach these people...! That's why...!」

737:t_009:28.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Come, evil species! We will destroy the $$バアル$$ that are bringing the universe to collapse!」

737:t_009:29.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You don't need to worry. You can leave everything afterward to $$テンプティ$$ and the others.」

737:t_009:30.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Waiting as unseen gods for humanity to attain $$シンカ$$ on its own did nothing but breed evil!」

737:t_009:31.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Once peace comes to the universe, we shall descend upon every parallel world and directly oversee humanity's evolution!」

737:t_009:32.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That arrogance...! You really are the fundamental calamity!」

737:t_009:33.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then we'll punch right through you and keep moving!」

737:t_009:34.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't think your selfish reasoning can stop our evolution... stop us from living!」
